_comment: GLM-5.3-Flash on Linux with TWO GPUs (branch linux-2gpu). Replace <REPO>, <DATA>, <GGUF_DIR>. Layers [0,K) run on CUDA0, [K,45) + head on CUDA1 (--layer-split K --split-device 1; CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID is set by the shell that starts the server). --resident-budget-gib: RAM for experts (128 GB box: 95). --pool-workers: 10 on a 6-core/12-thread CPU (do NOT use all threads). --vram-reserve-mib 3400 leaves room for the chunked prefill scratch. STRATA_GLM5_PF_MIN=256: continuations shorter than 256 new tokens use the sequential path. No expert skipping.
